mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is that HTTPS is used everywhere, with no exception for plain-text HTTP, internal hosts included. This rests on the fact that certificate management is already in place.
EOF
